questions.answer: A technical SEO audit covers crawlability and indexation, site architecture and internal linking, page speed and Core Web Vitals, structured data, duplicate and thin content, international setup where relevant, and AI crawler access [4]. The output is a prioritized list of fixes ranked by impact and effort rather than a dump of every tool warning [3][4]. Modern audits also evaluate SEO and user experience together, since changes in one often affect the other [1]. You can find more details on the [technical SEO service page](/services/technical-seo/), or reach out through the [contact page](/contact/) if you want to work with Joe on an audit.
